spans.s: वुक् (1) augment वु added (a) to the word भ्रू after it, when the tad. affix ढक् ( एय ) in the sense of अपत्य is affixed to it; cf. भ्रुवो वुक् च
; (b) to the root भू before an affix beginning with a vowel in the perfect and the aorist tenses; e.g. बभूव, अभूवन् etc.: cf.
